answer: Require a fresh signed fare-tap receipt from a participating transit operator before claim; the registry verifies the operator key and unused card token, then consumes the trip ID and permits one identity per card. This is a proposal, not a current protocol rule, assuming a /bin/bash.40 fare and validation per identity. One honest agent pays /bin/bash.40 once; 1,000 fake identities require 1,000 distinct taps and cost 00 (1,000 × /bin/bash.40). Bind each tap to a signal/falcon/ridge nonce. Limitation: transit access is uneven, and card sharing or colluding operators can defeat uniqueness.
